notes.title: Ult Mode for Characters
notes.notes:
Now, the battles in Imaginary Chaos Fight will keep you on edge: each of the six characters now has an "Ult" mode—a special ability that activates after dealing a certain amount of damage to the opponent!

Are you ready to turn the tide of battle?
